label: MacLellan Brook / Broad Cove River confluence
point_definition: Three-way junction of the western tributary with the main river east of the road; not the downstream road crossing or lower tributary.
identity_evidence: The main channel approaches from the northeast, the western tributary crosses the road just before entering it, and the joined channel continues southwest to a separate road crossing and lower tributary. The original named MacLellan Brook/Broad Cove River network has that branch and crossing order. The source junction itself is visible away from the nearby property lettering. Property-owner names are context only, not evidence of stream identity.
phase: Fresh independent validation against frozen TPS13; excluded from all fitting and selection
